title: Two Citrix NetScaler zero-day RCE flaws are under active exploitation. Citrix confirmed CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 and shipped patche
content_md:
Two Citrix NetScaler zero-day RCE flaws are under active exploitation. Citrix confirmed CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 and shipped patche

via Mastodon https://securityonline.info/citrix-netscaler-zero-day-rce/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=jetpack_social

CVE-2026-88771.evidence: Report says the two zero-day RCE flaws are under active exploitation and Citrix confirmed observed exploitation on unmitigated deployments.

CVE-2026-88772.evidence: Report says the two zero-day RCE flaws are under active exploitation and Citrix confirmed observed exploitation on unmitigated deployments.
